fact: Bank of Zambia directives dated 5 February 2020 require all commercial banks to be members of the National Financial Switch and, from a date to be determined by the Bank, require payment service providers to process domestic ATM, POS, internet and mobile transactions with other providers through it.
title: National Payment Systems Directives on Domestic Automated Teller Machine, Point of Sale, Internet Transactions and Mobile Payments, 2019
